versions.title: Version 1.0 (first revision)
versions.summary: First version: sets five Responsible AI principles (reliability/safety/security, inclusivity/fairness, accountability/lawfulness, privacy by design, transparency) for all AI development, deployment and use at eBay.

changes.detail: Applies to eBay Inc., subsidiaries, personnel and systems across the AI lifecycle; EU AI Act AI-system definition adopted
Owned by the Responsible AI team; reviewed annually; operationalised via Responsible AI Standard and Guidelines

versions.note: Text of v1.0 not available; only the version history entry in the v1.1 copy.

covered_entities: vendors (expected to adhere via the Supplier Code of Business Conduct & Ethics)
covered_systems: AI systems as defined in the EU AI Act, internal-facing and customer-facing
covered_activities: research, design, development, deployment, use and decommissioning of AI systems
conditions: risk-based: criticality and applicability of each principle depend on how and for what purpose the AI system is used
objective: Set eBay's core Responsible AI principles as the foundation of its Responsible AI program, guiding all development, deployment and use of AI at eBay.

eBay Supplier Code of Business Conduct & Ethics

conflict_rule: Principles may require trade-offs (e.g. transparency vs. security and privacy); operational detail is set by the Responsible AI Standard and Guidelines.

record_provenance.notes: Text taken from the copy in asago-ai/asago-policy-mapper (policy_examples/ebay.pdf). Document ID printed as 'EI-COREAI-POL-1. 0. 0. 1' (spacing is a PDF artefact). Header gives effective date Jan 17, 2024; version history lists 1.0 (Jan 17, 2024) and 1.1 (Dec 11, 2025); sign-off table also lists 2026 approvals (17 Feb and 4 Mar 2026), presumably for v1.1. Treated v1.1 as current; not checked whether a later version exists. EU AI Act link reflects only the adopted AI-system definition. binding=false (not law), but compliance is required of every eBay employee. Names of individual signatories and authors omitted.

clauses.original_text: Every AI system should consistently produce the expected outcome and task it is designed for, across various conditions and in a way that minimizes unpredictability and hallucinations. eBay should ensure appropriate testing and refining of the AI system to achieve this end.
clauses.requirement: AI systems perform reliably with minimal hallucination, ensured by testing and refinement
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: Section continues with regular safety assessments to identify and rectify issues.

clauses.original_text: eBay’s AI systems should be secure and protected from unauthorized access, tampering, and any other form of malicious intervention, in accordance with eBay’s Information Security Policy and Standards.
clauses.requirement: protect AI systems from unauthorised access, tampering and malicious intervention
clauses.affected_asset: AI systems; eBay and user data
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: Implemented through eBay's Information Security Policy and Standards (not included).

clauses.original_text: In particular, AI decisions must not discriminate based on age, gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic. To ensure fairness, we must build AI systems with fairness and bias issues in mind, test and monitor AI systems regularly and give users the ability to give us feedback.
clauses.requirement: no discrimination on protected characteristics; regular fairness testing/monitoring and user feedback
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: Combines a prohibition (no discrimination) with positive duties (MUST build/test/monitor, feedback channel).

clauses.original_text: In particular, human oversight should be integrated throughout the development, launch, and monitoring of AI systems. Throughout this lifecycle, decision-making should be informed by the level of risk and potential impact associated with the use case at hand.
clauses.object: AI system development, launch and monitoring
clauses.requirement: risk-proportionate human oversight across the AI lifecycle
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: Section also requires documenting development, deployment and oversight decisions.

clauses.original_text: To the extent personal information is involved, eBay’s Privacy principles—which are the backbone of eBay’s Privacy program—should guide choices for AI system design, development, deployment, and use. This includes following a Privacy by Design approach, data minimization, data quality, and purpose specification.
clauses.requirement: privacy by design, data minimisation, data quality and purpose specification
clauses.condition: to the extent personal information is involved
clauses.affected_asset: personal data of users and employees
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: eBay's Privacy principles themselves are not included in the document.

clauses.original_text: eBay should be transparent to users about its use of AI. We will promote transparency with disclosures about the type of AI being used within a particular experience or broader disclosures about our AI use more generally.
clauses.object: use of AI in eBay experiences
clauses.requirement: disclose AI use to users, specifically or generally, tailored to their needs
clauses.applicable_systems: eBay AI systems (internal-facing and customer-facing), across the lifecycle
clauses.interpretation_notes: Disclosure may be experience-specific or general; tailored to users' roles and understanding.
